findings.quote: "Does John Stark Regional High School serve Weare School District and is Weare, New Hampshire located in Merrimack County?"

findings.what_happened: The agent formulated the query as a conversational natural language question starting with 'Who is' instead of a dense keyword-rich search string.
findings.quote: "Who is the mother of Aiko, Princess Toshi, when was she born, and who is the current monarch of Japan?"
